description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git push options functionality, including setup of repositories, hooks, and test scenarios for push options behavior through local, submodule, and HTTP transports.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares specific refs in upstream and workbench repositories to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expecting success, running provided commands and validating expected outcomes.

methods.name: mk_http_pair
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP server with repositories configured for push options testing via HTTP, including cloning repo via HTTP.
